2122144351799345176.en_summary: Nassim Nicholas Taleb replies to @MaryJaneBryksa: Sorry, but I block bullshitters. Nothing personal.
2122144351799345176.zh_summary: 納西姆·尼古拉斯·塔勒布回覆@MaryJaneBryksa：抱歉，但我會封鎖胡說八道的人。沒有個人恩怨。

2122142977367953798.en_summary: Ming-Chi Kuo says OpenAI and Anthropic orders extend Google’s TPU shipment visibility through 2029: 2027 8M-9M, 2028 14M-15M, 2029 16M-18M. Estimates ~12M units for OpenAI and ~14M for Anthropic across 2028-29, even as many expect AI capex to peak in 2028. MediaTek and Broadcom lead as top suppliers.
2122142977367953798.zh_summary: 郭明錤表示OpenAI和Anthropic的訂單將谷歌TPU出貨能見度延長至2029年：2027年8M-9M、2028年14M-15M、2029年16M-18M。估計OpenAI約12M台、Anthropic約14M台（2028-29年），儘管許多人預期AI資本支出在2028年達峰。聯發科和博通是主要供應商。

2122140892727509271.en_summary: Questions whether OpenAI is not confident in their silicon lineup or relying on Google/MediaTek because they can't secure the supply chain, in context of large TPU orders.
2122140892727509271.zh_summary: 質疑OpenAI是否對自家晶片陣容缺乏信心，或因無法確保供應鏈而依賴谷歌/聯發科，背景是大量TPU訂單。

2122140595158446234.en_summary: Positive reaction 'YES👍' to Ming-Chi Kuo's estimates of large Google TPU shipments for OpenAI (~12M) and Anthropic (~14M) in 2028-29, calling the numbers 'Holy smoke'.
2122140595158446234.zh_summary: 對郭明錤估計的谷歌TPU大規模出貨（OpenAI約12M台、Anthropic約14M台，2028-29年）作出正面反應「YES👍」，並稱數字「Holy smoke」。

2122140169549607309.en_summary: DXY is still going up tonight, representing financial tightening ahead of a massive $1.5T IPO. Shows charts of DXY (left) and SPY (right).
2122140169549607309.zh_summary: 今晚DXY仍在上升，這是大規模1.5萬億美元IPO前的金融緊縮表現。展示DXY（左）和SPY（右）的圖表。
